text: Blockchain based fund reporting substitutes verifiable transparency for hedge fund secrecy: the LendingRobot ledger shows detailed holdings and supplies a hash code signature as evidence that the data is tamper proof.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Applications and Fee Structure Developments in Private Investment Funds (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2959730

isBasedOn.name: Blockchain Applications and Fee Structure Developments in Private Investment Funds

abstract: Unlike traditional hedge funds that are rather secretive, the LendingRobot ledger shows detailed holdings and provides a "hash code" signature as evidence that the data is tamper-proof in the blockchain.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: funds recording trades to a public blockchain ledger
weekly trade recording in the LendingRobot Series
